name: Kuromatsunai (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kuromatsunai town emblem in white: three curved arrows forming a ring around a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kuromatsunai, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 May 1959.

features.role: Kuromatsunai town emblem — three curved arrows forming a ring around a stylised character
